scope: Add evidence to ten existing exact identities only; no new products, prices, photos, aliases or installed-fit guarantees.

mini.scope: Exact O11DMINI-X / O11DMINI-W specification columns. Modular rear-panel/radiator layout remains a separate check; the page contradicts itself on GPU length.
mini.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.

4000d.scope: Exact standard 4000D Black / CC-9011198-WW; not Airflow, RGB or FRAME. Nominal published limits only.
4000d.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.

200r.scope: Exact CC-9011023-WW. Marketing body and Tech Specs disagree about GPU and CPU-cooler clearance, so neither number is promoted into a verified limit.
200r.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.

h500.scope: Exact H500/H500i manual; standard H500 catalog record only. Does not inherit H510 specs. Manual publishes 325 mm nominal GPU clearance; H510 or later-case figures are not inherited.
h500.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.

rmx2021.scope: Exact RMx2021 family manual. RM650x / RPS0122 / CP-9020198; RM750x / RPS0123 / CP-9020199; RM1000x / RPS0125 / CP-9020201. Regional AC suffixes and individual package contents are not inferred.
rmx2021.locator: PDF pages 4/5/9, English and French tables
rmx2021.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.

sf750.scope: Original SF750 Platinum / CP-9020186 / RPS0115 manual, not newer SF750 revisions or SF750L. Named SF750 table and labeled dimension axes.
sf750.locator: PDF page 4, SF750 power table and dimensions
sf750.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.

sf750-page.scope: Exact CP-9020186-NA product page corroborates 750 W and SFX. Website dimensions omit axes; the manual supplies the labeled 100 mm length.
sf750-page.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.

ax1600i.scope: AX1600i exact manual with labeled 200 mm body length. Package AC lead and circuit requirements must be checked separately.
ax1600i.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.

ax1600i-page.scope: Exact CP-9020087-NA:1600W continuous rating and ATX form. No available-circuit or cable suitability guarantee.
ax1600i-page.inspection: Original manufacturer product page or exact manual inspected. Facts are specifications; no physical fit, electrical, thermal or acoustic testing is claimed.
